_comment: dose-cite-v2 verdict fixtures, one named group per clause of the rule. Each case: a reply + a source set (a name from sources.json, or an inline array) -> the expected verdict fields. WITHHELD stands for lookup-guard.js WITHHELD_BANNER and a displayText of exactly NO_EVIDENCE for LOOKUP_NO_EVIDENCE_TEXT. "probe N" cases are the fix-round-1 re-review adversarial pairs (all withheld). The canonical rule is src/triage/lookup-guard.js; the triage repo vendors it and asserts identity group by group.
